recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait of a man with dark skin, focusing on his intense gaze, overlaid with falling cyan confetti and a large, textured title at the bottom. The image features high-contrast lighting, heavy film grain, and a cool-toned color grade.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's eyes act as the primary focal point, drawing the viewer into the intensity of the expression.
The cyan confetti creates a sense of depth and motion, blurring in the foreground and background.
The heavy, textured title at the bottom anchors the composition and provides a tactile contrast to the smooth skin textures.
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up framing of the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 80% of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to emphasize the eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, arched title at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-center artist name, down to the subject's eyes, following the diagonal confetti to the main title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with facial features, patterns, and confetti.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the skin and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright cyan/teal for the confetti and lighting highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver/white for the textured typography and eye reflections.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights in the eyes and confetti.

letterConstructionRules: Arched baseline and cap-height for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are vertically elongated and tapered to fit a curved path.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-condensed arched display type and wide, flat secondary type.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed, heavy weight for the main title.
Matches the wide, technical look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up of a man's face with dark skin and an intense gaze. Apply a cool-toned color grade with cyan highlights. Add falling rectangular cyan confetti with motion blur. Apply heavy film grain and high contrast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large arched title at the bottom using an ultra-condensed bold sans-serif. Apply a silver glitter texture and small lens flares to the corners of the letters. Add a secondary wide sans-serif title at the top center in plain white.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture consistent across the image?
Does the arched text follow a smooth curve?
Is the cyan color consistent between the confetti and the lighting?
Are the eyes sharp and clear despite the grain?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Any brand logos on the clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic skin texture under the grain.
Ensure the glitter texture on the text doesn't look like flat noise.
Verify the confetti doesn't obscure the eyes.
Confirm the arched text is centered perfectly.
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme close-up portrait + cyan motion-blurred confetti + heavy grain + arched textured display typography.
